title: Eggs Price in USA: California Pricing Challenge Clears a Court Hurdle
description:
The “eggs price in USA” debate has a new court development: an October 5, 2026, report says a judge denied California’s motion to dismiss the United States’ egg-pricing challenge. That is not a final ruling, and the supplied October 5 shell-egg report headline contains no dollar figures to verify today’s egg price or name the cheapest retailer.
